Government Considers Uniform Rules for Messaging Apps After WhatsApp Row

India's Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) is considering uniform regulations for all messaging platforms following a dispute over WhatsApp's username feature. WhatsApp has responded to a government notice regarding this feature, and the ministry is reviewing its reply. Telegram has also responded to a similar notice concerning its username feature. The government is exploring the possibility of establishing consistent standards for messaging applications.
